privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy is fundamental to us. This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your data.

s1.title: 1. Information We Collect
s1.usageText: Pages visited, features used, session duration.
s1.crmText: Contacts, deals, pipelines and other information you enter into the system.
s1.paymentText: Processed exclusively by Mercado Pago. We do not store credit card data.

s2.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
s2.provideText: Manage your account, process payments, send notifications.
s2.improveText: Analyze aggregate usage to identify improvements and bugs.
s2.communicateText: Send transactional emails (account confirmation, invoices) and marketing (with opt-out).
s2.securityText: Detect and prevent fraud, abuse and attacks.
s2.neverSell: We never sell your data to third parties.

s3.title: 3. Data Isolation (Multi-Tenant)
s3.p1: Each organization's data is completely isolated. Users of {orgA} can never view or access data from {orgB}.
s3.p2: All database queries include a filter by {field} to ensure absolute isolation.

s4.title: 4. Security Measures
s4.encryptionText: Passwords with bcrypt, data in transit via HTTPS/TLS.
s4.authText: JWT tokens with expiration, HttpOnly and SameSite cookies.
s4.dbText: PostgreSQL hosted on secure servers with daily backups.
s4.monitoringText: Access logs and error monitoring via Sentry.

s5.title: 5. Cookies and Tracking
s5.essentialText: Required for authentication and system operation.
s5.analyticsText: We use GA4 for aggregated usage analysis (anonymized).

s6.title: 6. Data Sharing
s6.dpa: All partners sign DPAs (Data Processing Agreements) in compliance with LGPD.

s7.title: 7. Your Rights (LGPD)
s7.intro: Under the General Data Protection Law (LGPD), you have the right to:
s7.accessText: Request a copy of all your data.
s7.deletionText: Delete your account and all associated data.
s7.portabilityText: Export your data in a readable format.
s7.revocationText: Withdraw consent for marketing at any time.
s7.contact: To exercise your rights, send an email to:

s8.title: 8. Data Retention
s8.activeText: We retain your data while your account is active.
s8.afterCancelText: Data is retained for 90 days for recovery, then permanently deleted.
s8.logsText: Retained for 1 year for security purposes.

s9.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
s9.p1: We may update this policy periodically. Significant changes will be communicated by email with 30 days' notice.
s9.p2: We recommend reviewing this page regularly.

cta.title: Questions about privacy?
cta.subtitle: Our team is available to clarify any questions about how we handle your data.

1.title: Automatic confirmations
1.text: Send appointment confirmation as soon as the booking is made, with 1-click cancellation or rescheduling link.

2.title: Smart reminders
2.text: Set up reminders 24h and 1h in advance. Reduce no-shows without calling each patient.

3.title: Inactive patient recall
3.text: Identify patients who haven't returned in X days and send a personalized message with recommended protocol.

4.title: Official Meta API
4.text: Integration via Official WhatsApp Business API via Meta. No ban risk, with media support and approved templates.

5.title: Unified inbox

1.text: Go to Settings > Integrations > WhatsApp and follow the authorization wizard via Meta Business Manager.

2.title: Create message templates
2.text: Use Estetia's ready-made templates or create your own. Templates are automatically approved by Meta within 24h.

3.title: Set up automation triggers
3.text: Define when each message should be sent: on booking confirmation, 24h before, 1h before, or due to inactivity.

4.title: Track results
4.text: Monitor delivery, read and reply rates in the Analytics panel. Adjust cadence based on data.

1.a: Yes, you need an active WhatsApp Business number. It can be your current number — we handle the portability with guided support.

2.q: Is there a ban risk to my number?
2.a: No. We use the Official WhatsApp Business API via Meta, which is the only safe integration. Unofficial integrations carry ban risk.

3.q: How many messages can I send per month?
3.a: It depends on your plan and WhatsApp Business account. Estetia doesn't charge per message — you only pay Meta if you exceed the free conversation quota.

4.a: Yes. Create templates with dynamic variables like patient name, procedure, date and time. We also have ready-made templates to get started quickly.

detail.headline: Estetia and Google Calendar always in sync
detail.planInfo: Available on Starter plan and above.

1.title: Two-way sync
1.text: Create a booking in Estetia and it appears in Google Calendar — and vice versa. Always updated, no duplicates.

2.title: Multiple professionals
2.text: Connect each clinic professional's Google Calendar. Each one sees only their appointments.

3.title: Automatic time blocking
3.text: Personal events in Google Calendar automatically block slots in Estetia. No more scheduling conflicts.

4.title: Native notifications
4.text: Use the Google Calendar notifications you already know. Estetia and Calendar reminders work together.

1.title: Authorize Estetia in Google
1.text: Go to Settings > Integrations > Google Calendar and click Connect with Google. Authorize access to your calendar.

2.title: Choose which calendars to sync
2.text: Select each professional's main calendar. You can exclude personal calendars from sync.

3.title: Done — calendars stay in sync
3.text: New bookings, cancellations and changes appear in real time in both systems.

1.scenario: Has used Google Calendar on her phone for years. With the integration, she keeps using the app she prefers while bookings automatically appear in Estetia.

2.scenario: Works at two offices. Connected each unit's Google Calendar and never has scheduling conflicts between locations anymore.

3.scenario: Views all professionals' occupancy in the shared Google Calendar with the management team.

1.a: Yes. New bookings appear in Google Calendar within seconds. Changes and cancellations are also synced immediately.

2.a: Yes. Each clinic professional can connect their Google account individually. There's no limit to connected accounts.

3.a: Sync is prospective — it covers new bookings from the connection point. Historical appointments are not retroactively imported.

4.title: Issue NFS-e for private patients

3.scenario: Issues NFS-e directly from the patient record after each appointment. Never needs to log into a separate city hall system again.

detail.headline: Connect Estetia to any tool with visual automations
detail.planInfo: Available on Starter plan and above. Self-hosted or N8N Cloud.

1.title: Unlimited integrations
1.text: N8N connects Estetia to hundreds of tools: Google Sheets, Slack, CRMs, ERPs, email marketing and more.

2.title: Visual no-code automations
2.text: Build automation flows by dragging blocks. No programming needed to create powerful workflows.

3.text: Receive Estetia notifications in N8N instantly when bookings are created, payments confirmed or procedures recorded.

2.title: Create a webhook in Estetia
2.text: In Estetia, go to Integrations > Webhooks and create a webhook pointing to your N8N. Choose which events trigger it.

3.title: Build your automation flow
3.text: In N8N, construct the workflow connecting the Estetia trigger to desired actions in other tools.

4.title: Activate and monitor
4.text: Activate the workflow and track executions in N8N's panel. Estetia also logs webhook events for debugging.

2.scenario: Payment confirmed → N8N creates record in accounting ERP, without manual invoice entry.

1.a: Not necessarily. You can use N8N Cloud (free plan available) or host for free on Railway or Render.

2.q: Does Estetia have an official N8N node?
2.a: Currently via REST API + Webhooks, which works with N8N's HTTP Request node. A native node is on the roadmap.

3.q: Which events does Estetia send via webhook?
3.a: Booking created/cancelled, payment confirmed, patient created, anamnesis filled, and more. See full API documentation.

apiWebhooks.name: API & Webhooks
apiWebhooks.shortDesc: Full REST API and webhooks on all events. Build custom integrations with total control.

detail.headline: Open REST API to integrate Estetia with any system
detail.planInfo: API available on Pro and Business plans. Webhooks available from Starter.

1.title: Full REST API
1.text: Endpoints for patients, bookings, records, financials and more. Authentication via secure API Key.

2.title: Webhooks on all events
2.text: Receive real-time notifications at any URL when bookings are created, payments confirmed, anamneses filled and more.

3.title: OpenAPI documentation
3.text: Interactive documentation in OpenAPI (Swagger) format. Test endpoints directly in the docs without needing an HTTP client.

4.title: Webhook logs
4.text: Complete history of each dispatch: payload sent, response received, status and retry attempts.

5.title: Generous rate limiting
5.text: 1,000 req/min on Pro, 5,000 req/min on Business. Ideal for real-time integrations and high volume.

1.title: Generate your API Key
1.text: Go to Settings > API & Integrations > Generate key. Each integration should use a separate key for access control.

2.title: Explore the documentation
2.text: Visit docs.estetiacrm.com.br and test endpoints interactively. All examples have code in cURL, JavaScript and Python.

3.title: Configure your webhooks
3.text: In Settings > Webhooks, add the destination URL and select the events you want to receive.

4.title: Monitor and debug
4.text: View each webhook's log in the panel. Resend specific payloads to test your integration without generating real data.

1.scenario: Built integration with the clinic's legacy system in 2 days. The REST API covered 100% of use cases without needing database access.

2.scenario: Developed a custom telemedicine module that connects to Estetia via API to fetch patient records and bookings.

3.scenario: Uses webhooks to feed their BI system in real time. Each booking or payment triggers an update to the dashboard.

1.a: Yes. Full documentation in OpenAPI (Swagger) at docs.estetiacrm.com.br with examples in multiple languages.

2.a: Yes. On failure (timeout or status >= 400), Estetia automatically retries in 5min, 30min and 2h. After 3 attempts, the webhook is marked as failed in the log.

3.q: Can I use the API on the free plan?
3.a: Webhooks are available from Starter. The full REST API is available on Pro and Business plans.

4.q: Is there a sandbox for testing?
4.a: Yes. Each account has a separate sandbox environment for development. Sandbox data never affects production.

whatsappEvolution.name: WhatsApp Evolution
whatsappEvolution.shortDesc: Self-hosted WhatsApp API — full control of your instance, no Meta dependency.

detail.headline: WhatsApp without API costs — host your own instance and pay only for infrastructure
detail.planInfo: Available on Pro and Business plans.

1.title: Zero per-message cost
1.text: No per-conversation fees to Meta. Only hosting cost (VPS or Docker), typically under R$ 50/month.

2.title: Full instance control
2.text: You manage the number, QR code and settings. Ideal for clinics with in-house IT or technical partners.

3.title: Multiple agents
3.text: Connect as many agents as needed to the same number. Estetia's Chat Center distributes conversations automatically.

4.title: Unlimited automations
4.text: Send confirmations, reminders and recalls without quota limits. Integrates with N8N and Make for complex flows.

1.title: Install Evolution API
1.text: Use the Docker Compose provided by Evolution (open source). Runs on any 1GB RAM VPS in under 10 minutes.

2.title: Generate the API Key
2.text: In the Evolution panel, create an instance and copy the API Key and server URL.

3.title: Configure in Estetia
3.text: Under Settings > Integrations > WhatsApp Evolution, paste the URL and API Key. Connect via QR code.

4.title: Activate flows
4.text: Configure which events trigger messages: appointment created, D-1 reminder, payment confirmation and recall.

1.scenario: Switched from WhatsApp Business API to Evolution and reduced communication costs from R$ 800/month to R$ 45/month.

2.scenario: Each unit has its own instance. The CRM consolidates all conversations in a single centralized Chat Center.

3.scenario: Sets up Evolution for clients without Meta Business accounts. 20-minute setup, no template approval needed.

1.a: Yes, to a lesser degree. Evolution API uses the unofficial WhatsApp version. Don't send spam and keep block rates low. For high volume with guarantees, use Official WhatsApp.

2.q: Does it need a dedicated server?
2.a: No. Works on any VPS with 1GB RAM. Digital Ocean, Hetzner or Contabo from €4/month are enough.

3.q: Can I use my current number?
3.a: Yes. Scan the QR code with the number you already use. If it's on WhatsApp Business, even better.

whatsappZapi.name: WhatsApp Z-API
whatsappZapi.shortDesc: Brazilian WhatsApp provider — 5-minute setup, Portuguese support.

detail.headline: WhatsApp with Brazilian support and hassle-free setup

1.title: 5-minute setup
1.text: No Meta Business Manager, no account approval. Create an instance in Z-API, scan the QR and connect to Estetia.

2.title: Portuguese support
2.text: Brazilian team available via WhatsApp and email. Response in hours, not days. Ideal for non-technical users.

3.title: Fixed predictable pricing
3.text: Fixed plan in BRL (~R$ 99/month). No per-conversation fees. 100% predictable cost for the clinic budget.

4.title: Proven stability
4.text: Hundreds of Brazilian clinics use Z-API. 99.5% uptime with infrastructure based in Brazil.

1.title: Create Z-API account
1.text: Visit z-api.io and create an instance. The basic plan includes everything the clinic needs.

2.title: Connect the number
2.text: Scan the QR code with the WhatsApp on the receptionist's phone or a dedicated clinic number.

3.title: Configure in Estetia
3.text: Under Settings > Integrations > WhatsApp Z-API, paste the Token and Instance ID provided by Z-API.

4.title: Activate triggers
4.text: Choose which events send messages: appointment confirmation, 24h-before reminder, inactive patient recall.

1.scenario: Owner without IT configured it alone in an afternoon. Now 80% of confirmations come via WhatsApp, without calling.

2.scenario: Uses the same personal WhatsApp number for care. With Z-API, automated messages go out from her number.

3.scenario: Tested Z-API before getting Official WhatsApp. When they reached 2,000 patients, migrated to Meta API with history preserved.

1.a: No. Z-API connects to WhatsApp Web. No anti-ban guarantee, but stable for moderate volumes (up to ~500 messages/day).

2.q: What happens if the phone loses internet?
2.a: The instance goes offline. Z-API recommends keeping the phone always connected or using a dedicated SIM.

3.q: Can I migrate to Official WhatsApp later?
3.a: Yes. Estetia keeps the history. Just disconnect Z-API, connect the Meta API and reassociate the number.

instagramDirect.name: Instagram Direct
instagramDirect.shortDesc: Receive and reply to Instagram DMs directly in Estetia's Chat Center.

detail.headline: Turn Instagram DMs into attended patients
detail.planInfo: Available on Pro and Business plans.

1.title: Never miss a DM lead
1.text: Every Instagram direct message arrives in the Chat Center. No need to switch apps or miss messages on your phone.

2.title: Automatic quick reply
2.text: Set up welcome messages for new DM contacts. Capture name and interest before the human takes over.

3.title: Unified patient history
3.text: Instagram conversations live in the same patient profile in the CRM, alongside WhatsApp, appointments and clinical history.

4.title: Meta Business integration
4.text: Uses the official Instagram API (Meta). Safe, no ban risk. Supports multiple Instagram accounts.

1.title: Connect your Business account
1.text: Your Instagram needs to be a Professional Account (Business or Creator) linked to a Facebook Page.

2.title: Authorize in Meta Business
2.text: Under Settings > Integrations > Instagram Direct, click Connect and authorize access via Meta Business Suite.

3.title: Set up automatic replies
3.text: Define welcome messages for new followers who reach out and set business hours.

4.title: Distribute to the team
4.text: Assign Instagram conversations to specific agents or use the Chat Center's automatic queue.

1.scenario: Receives 40 DMs per week from people interested in botox. With the Chat Center, the team responds to all of them in under 5 minutes.

2.scenario: Has 80K followers and only received DMs on the phone. With the integration, no more missed leads and conversations are tracked.

3.scenario: Each unit has its own Instagram profile. The CRM centralizes all DMs with routing by city.

1.q: Does it need a Business Instagram account?
1.a: Yes. Personal accounts don't have access to the messaging API. Converting to Business is free and takes 1 minute.

2.q: Does it work with Instagram Stories?
2.a: Yes. Story replies via DM also arrive in the Chat Center.

3.a: The Meta API allows up to 1,000 active conversations per day on the standard tier. Enough for any clinic.

asaas.name: Asaas
asaas.shortDesc: PIX, bank slip and card with recurring billing. Brazil's preferred fintech for clinics.

detail.headline: Eliminate overdue payments with automatic PIX and bank slip billing

1.title: Native PIX with QR Code
1.text: Generate PIX charges directly from the appointment. The patient pays on the spot, no card reader needed.

2.title: Bank slip and credit card
2.text: Issue bank slips with due dates and installment on credit card. Ideal for high-value procedures.

3.title: Subscriptions and recurring billing
3.text: Create monthly plans for frequent patients. Billing is automatic by card or bank slip, no manual work.

4.title: Automatic reconciliation
4.text: Each payment received in Asaas automatically updates the patient record and the Estetia financial module.

5.title: Anti-fraud and compliance
5.text: Asaas is PCI-DSS certified. Your financial data is protected.

1.title: Open your Asaas account
1.text: Visit asaas.com and open your free account (business entity). Approval within 24h. No monthly fee.

2.title: Connect to Estetia
2.text: Under Settings > Integrations > Asaas, paste your Asaas API Key. Sync starts immediately.

3.title: Create charges in the patient record
3.text: In the patient profile, click New Charge. Choose PIX, bank slip or card and the amount.

4.title: Monitor in financials
4.text: All payments and overdue accounts appear in Estetia's Financial module in real time.

1.scenario: Offers a monthly skincare plan for R$ 350. Asaas charges automatically to the card every month, no manual work.

2.scenario: Installments R$ 5,000 procedures up to 12x. The CRM records each installment and notifies before due date.

3.scenario: Generates PIX QR Code during scheduling. Patient pays before even arriving at the clinic.

1.a: The account is free. Transaction fees: PIX 1%, Bank Slip R$ 1.99 + 1%, Card 2.99% + R$ 0.49. No monthly fee.

2.q: Does the money go directly to my account?
2.a: Yes. Asaas deposits D+0 (PIX), D+1 (Bank Slip) or D+30 (Card) to your bank account.

3.q: Does it need to be a business?
3.a: Yes. Asaas is for MEI, ME and companies. CPF to receive payments uses a different account (e.g. Mercado Pago).

stripe.name: Stripe
stripe.shortDesc: International payments with credit card, debit and payment links.

detail.headline: Accept international payments and premium payment links
detail.planInfo: Available on Pro and Business plans.

1.title: International cards
1.text: Accept Visa, Mastercard, Amex from any country. Ideal for clinics serving tourists or international patients.

2.title: Elegant payment link
2.text: Generate payment links with the clinic's branding. Send via WhatsApp and receive in seconds.

3.title: Subscriptions and recurring billing
3.text: Create subscription plans for monthly protocols. Automatic billing with no manual work.

4.title: Integrated checkout
4.text: Patients pay without leaving your website or app. Premium experience that increases conversion.

1.title: Create Stripe account
1.text: Visit stripe.com/br and create your account. Immediate approval. No monthly fee.

2.title: Connect to Estetia
2.text: Under Settings > Integrations > Stripe, click Connect with Stripe. Authorize access in 1 click.

3.title: Issue charges
3.text: In the patient profile, choose Stripe as payment method. Generate a link or charge the card directly.

4.title: Monitor in financials
4.text: All Stripe payments appear in the Financial module with automatic reconciliation.

1.scenario: Serves patients from Argentina and the USA. Stripe processes payments in USD and EUR directly.

2.scenario: Uses Stripe payment link in digital quotes. Procedure approval and payment in one step.

3.scenario: Offers annual subscription plan with discount. Stripe manages renewals automatically.

1.q: What is Stripe's rate in Brazil?
1.a: 2.9% + R$ 0.50 per approved card transaction. PIX and bank slip are available via Stripe in Brazil.

2.q: Does it work with debit cards?
2.a: Yes. Stripe accepts international debit cards. For domestic Brazilian debit, Asaas or Mercado Pago are better options.

3.q: How soon do I receive the money?
3.a: Stripe deposits in D+2 by default. Can be accelerated to D+0 on higher-volume plans.

pagseguro.name: PagSeguro
pagseguro.shortDesc: PagBank — checkout, payment link and card reader integrated with Estetia.

detail.headline: PagBank in the CRM — from payment link to card reader in one place

1.title: Established brand in Brazil
1.text: PagSeguro/PagBank is trusted and well-known. Patients have more confidence paying on recognized platforms.

2.title: Payment link
2.text: Send payment link via WhatsApp with procedure amount and description. Pay by card, PIX or bank slip.

3.title: Recurring billing
3.text: Create monthly plans with automatic billing. Ideal for protocols and treatment packages.

4.title: Integrated PagBank account
4.text: Receive payments directly in your PagBank account and transfer to your bank at any time.

1.title: Create PagBank account
1.text: Visit pagbank.com.br and create your free business account. Approval in hours.

2.title: Get your credentials
2.text: In the PagBank panel, generate your integration Token under Settings > Integrations.

3.title: Configure in Estetia
3.text: Under Settings > Integrations > PagSeguro, paste the Token and PagBank account email.

4.title: Issue charges
4.text: In the patient profile, select PagSeguro as payment method. Generate a link or PIX QR Code in seconds.

1.scenario: Already uses PagBank card reader at the front desk. With the integration, in-person payment automatically updates the CRM.

2.scenario: 12-session packages with payment link. Patient pays in 12x installments, clinic receives in D+30.

3.scenario: Sends payment link via WhatsApp 24h before the appointment. No-show rate dropped 35%.

1.q: PagSeguro or Asaas? Which to choose?
1.a: Asaas has lower fees for bank slips and PIX. PagSeguro is better if you already use the PagBank card reader or have a PagBank account.

2.a: Yes. Installments up to 12x with or without interest. You decide whether to absorb the interest or pass it to the patient.

3.a: Yes. PagSeguro has its own anti-fraud system with automatic approval for low-risk transactions.

googleAds.name: Google Ads
googleAds.shortDesc: Capture Google leads directly into your pipeline and measure the real cost per booked appointment.

detail.headline: Stop guessing ROI — measure the real cost of every patient acquired via Google
detail.planInfo: Available on Pro and Business plans.

1.title: Real cost per appointment
1.text: See exactly how much you spent on ads for each appointment actually performed, not just clicks or leads.

2.title: Leads with automatic UTM
2.text: Every Google Ads lead arrives in Estetia tagged with the campaign, ad group and originating keyword.

3.title: Offline conversions for Google
3.text: Send back to Google which leads became patients. The algorithm optimizes campaigns for higher-value customers.

4.title: Inactive patient retargeting
4.text: Export lists of patients who haven't returned in 6 months and create targeted retargeting campaigns.

1.title: Set up Google Tag Manager
1.text: Install GTM on the clinic website. Estetia provides ready-made tags to track contact forms.

2.title: Connect your Google Ads account
2.text: Under Settings > Integrations > Google Ads, sign in with the ad manager's Google account.

3.title: Enable conversion tracking
3.text: Select which Estetia events to send to Google: lead created, appointment booked, payment received.

4.title: Monitor ROAS in the dashboard
4.text: In Estetia's Analytics module, view by campaign: leads, bookings, revenue and ROAS calculated automatically.

1.scenario: Discovered that botox campaigns had CAC of R$ 45 and biostimulator R$ 280. Reallocated budget and reduced cost by 40%.

2.scenario: By sending offline conversions to Google, the algorithm started bringing leads 3x more likely to close high-value procedures.

3.scenario: Each unit has its own conversion ID. The centralized report shows which unit has the best ROAS per campaign.

1.a: Yes for web tracking. For offline conversions (via API), only the Google Ads account ID is needed.

2.a: The integration is free. Ad spend is set by you directly in Google Ads.

3.q: Does it work with Google Analytics 4?
3.a: Yes. Estetia can send events to GA4 via Measurement Protocol, complementing the tracking.

metaAds.name: Meta Ads
metaAds.shortDesc: Facebook & Instagram Ads with full attribution — know exactly which ads generate appointments.

detail.headline: Close the loop between ad and booked appointment in Meta Ads
detail.planInfo: Available on Pro and Business plans.

1.title: Lead Forms imported automatically
1.text: Leads from Facebook and Instagram native forms arrive in Estetia within 60 seconds, ready for follow-up.

2.title: Cost per booked appointment
2.text: Not just cost per lead — see how much you spent for each appointment actually performed via Meta Ads.

3.title: Conversions API (CAPI)
3.text: Send conversion events server-side, bypassing ad blockers. More accurate data, more efficient campaigns.

4.title: Custom audiences
4.text: Export Estetia patients to create Lookalike Audiences in Meta. Advertise to people similar to your best patients.

1.title: Connect Meta Business
1.text: Under Settings > Integrations > Meta Ads, sign in with the Meta Business Suite admin profile.

2.title: Select the ad account
2.text: Choose which ad account to sync. Supports multiple accounts for clinic networks.

3.title: Configure conversion events
3.text: Select: Lead Created, Appointment Booked, Payment Received. Estetia sends via CAPI automatically.

4.title: Analyze performance
4.text: In the Analytics panel, filter by Meta Ads source and view the full funnel from click to patient.

1.scenario: Rhinoplasty Lead Forms arrive in the CRM in 1 minute. The agent calls while the lead is still hot.

2.scenario: With CAPI, recovered 30% of conversions iOS was blocking. ROAS increased 25% without raising budget.

3.scenario: Exported list of patients who had procedures over R$ 2,000 and created Lookalike. CPA dropped 40%.

1.a: CAPI is a server-to-server API that sends conversion events directly from the server to Meta, without relying on the browser pixel.

2.q: Do Lead Forms work without a website?
2.a: Yes! Facebook/Instagram native Lead Forms don't need a website. The lead fills out within the social network itself.

3.q: Does it work with Instagram Ads?
3.a: Yes. Meta Ads manages Facebook and Instagram on the same platform. All events are tracked.

zapier.name: Zapier
zapier.shortDesc: Connect Estetia to 5,000+ apps without writing a single line of code.

detail.headline: Automate without code — connect Estetia to any app in minutes

1.title: 5,000+ native integrations
1.text: Gmail, Google Sheets, Mailchimp, Calendly, ActiveCampaign, Typeform — if it's on Zapier, it connects with Estetia.

2.title: No-code automations
2.text: Build Trigger > Action flows in minutes. No developer or technical knowledge required.

3.title: Ready-made clinic templates
3.text: Use pre-built Zaps: new lead > Google Sheet, appointment created > custom confirmation email.

4.title: Ideal for small teams
4.text: Automate repetitive tasks that take the receptionist hours. Stock alerts, reports, notifications — on autopilot.

1.title: Create Zapier account
1.text: Visit zapier.com and create a free account. The Free plan allows up to 100 tasks/month.

2.title: Connect Estetia as Trigger
2.text: In Zapier, search for Estetia CRM. Configure the Estetia webhook as the trigger (e.g. New Appointment).

3.title: Configure the Action
3.text: Choose the destination app (e.g. Google Sheets) and map Estetia fields to the destination.

4.title: Test and activate
4.text: Zapier tests the flow with real data. If all good, activate and the Zap runs automatically.

1.scenario: Every new website lead goes automatically to a control spreadsheet and receives a welcome email.

2.scenario: Patients who complete treatment are automatically added to a reactivation campaign in Mailchimp.

3.scenario: Receives a Slack notification whenever a VIP patient books an appointment.

1.a: The free plan includes 100 tasks/month and 2-step Zaps. For higher-volume clinics, the Starter plan (~$19/month) is sufficient.

2.q: How is it different from N8N?
2.a: Zapier is simpler with no server required. N8N is more powerful and self-hostable. Start with Zapier, migrate to N8N when you need more control.

3.q: Can I use Zapier and N8N at the same time?
3.a: Yes. Use Zapier for simple, quick automations and N8N for complex flows requiring advanced logic.

make.name: Make (Integromat)
make.shortDesc: Advanced visual automations — Zapier for those who need more power.

detail.headline: Complex automation flows with visual builder — no code, no limits

1.title: Powerful visual builder
1.text: Build multi-step flows by dragging and connecting modules. Loops, conditionals, iterators — all visual.

2.title: Cheaper than Zapier at scale
2.text: Make charges per operation, not per task. At high volumes, the cost can be 5x lower.

3.title: Native data transformation
3.text: Manipulate JSON, perform calculations, filter lists — all inside Make without external code.

4.title: 1,000+ integrations
4.text: All essential apps: Google Workspace, HubSpot, Slack, Notion, Typeform and much more.

1.title: Create Make account
1.text: Visit make.com and create your account. The free plan includes 1,000 operations/month.

2.title: Create a Scenario
2.text: In Make, create a new Scenario. Add the Estetia CRM module as the trigger (e.g. Watch New Appointments).

3.title: Configure actions
3.text: Add destination modules (Google Sheets, email, Slack) and map Estetia data to each field.

4.title: Schedule execution
4.text: Define whether the scenario runs every 15 minutes, hourly, or in real-time via instant webhook.

1.scenario: Automation that consolidates appointments from 5 units into a control Google Sheet, with overbooking alerts.

2.scenario: Syncs Estetia data with the company BI every hour. Make transforms and formats the data along the way.

3.scenario: New patient onboarding flow: creates account, sends welcome kit, schedules coordinator call.

1.q: Make or Zapier? Which to choose?
1.a: Zapier is simpler for basic automations. Make is more powerful for complex flows and more cost-effective at scale above 1,000 tasks/month.

2.q: Do you need to know how to code?
2.a: No. The visual builder covers 95% of cases. For the remaining 5%, Make has a JavaScript module for custom logic.

3.a: Yes. Founded in 2012 (as Integromat), it has processed 5 billion operations. Acquired by Celonis in 2020.

1.a: Integrations are included in the plans that support them, at no additional cost. Only WhatsApp Business API (Meta) may have extra cost if you exceed the free conversation quota.

2.q: How long does it take to set up an integration?
2.a: Most integrations take 5 to 15 minutes. WhatsApp Business may take up to 24h waiting for Meta's template approval.

3.q: Can I use multiple integrations at the same time?
3.a: Yes. You can activate all integrations in your plan simultaneously. There's no limit to active integrations.

4.q: What happens to my data if I disconnect an integration?
4.a: Data generated by Estetia remains intact. Disconnecting an integration only stops syncing new data — nothing is deleted.

5.q: Is there technical support for setting up integrations?
5.a: Yes. All paid plans include support for integration setup. The Business plan includes dedicated support with 2h SLA.

notFound.title: Didn't find the integration you need?
notFound.subtitle: Use our open API to connect any system, or talk to us to suggest a new native integration.
